title: Clinic visits (one row per patient visit)
summary: One row per patient visit from Valdena's clinic system, with pseudonymised patient key, visit timestamp, age band, postcode and diagnosis code. Contains 900k rows covering from 2019 to present, refreshed daily. However, the clinic data policy (wiki: clinic_data_policy, last edited 2025-02-01) explicitly prohibits using this patient-level table for this analysis — only daily district counts may be used. The table contains personal data (pseudonymised patient key, age band, postcode) and requires Data Protection Office approval which has not been granted for this use case.

schema.notes: All columns documented in catalog entry. Three columns flagged as PII.

spatial.notes: Geography is via patient postcode field (Italian CAP codes). Only Valdena-area clinics.
